strategies.name: Baseline Sequential All-Reduce Chain
strategies.desc: Execute 8 sequential all-reduce operations (one per stage) with local bidiagonal coupling/uncoupling between each. Each stage performs: (1) undo previous coupling, (2) apply new coupling, (3) all-reduce. Results in exactly 8 collective dispatches with full W*S payload each time. Represents the straightforward translation of the problem with minimal optimization but maximum clarity.

strategies.name: Reduce-Scatter + All-Gather Decomposition
strategies.desc: Replace each all-reduce with reduce-scatter followed by all-gather, keeping only the owned shard between stages. Each rank performs local coupling only on its assigned shard during the 8 iterations, then reconstructs the full vector via all-gather at the end. Results in 16 collective dispatches (8 RS + 8 AG) but with smaller per-dispatch payload (W*S/W = S for reduce-scatter outputs), trading dispatch count for reduced bandwidth per operation.

strategies.name: Hierarchical Two-Level Reduction
strategies.desc: Exploit multi-node topology by splitting the 8 stages into intra-node and inter-node phases. Perform node-local reductions first (across cores within each node), then cross-node reductions, applying bidiagonal coupling at the node granularity. Reduces cross-node traffic at the cost of additional intra-node collectives, potentially 16+ dispatches but with better network utilization on hierarchical interconnects.

strategies.name: Fused Local-Op Pipelined Waves
strategies.desc: Overlap the coupling/uncoupling local operations with collective communication by chunking the W*S tensor into smaller blocks and pipelining across the 8 stages. Launch all 8 all-reduce operations with dependencies encoded via async barriers, fusing the intermediate coupling transforms into the collective's pre/post-processing hooks. Maintains 8 dispatches but enables compute-communication overlap and potential latency hiding.

strategies.name: Transpose-Batch-Transpose with Single Mega-Reduce
strategies.desc:
Restructure the computation by transposing data layout so that all 8 stages' intermediate results are computed locally as independent "batch" dimensions, then perform a single batched all-reduce operation across all stages simultaneously. Reshape from (8, W, S) to (W, 8*S) for the collective, then locally extract per-stage results. Results in 1 collective dispatch with 8× payload size, optimizing for dispatch overhead at the cost of memory footprint and single large transfer.
